fields.title: Aster Home BP monitor
fields.statement: Fictional battery-powered upper-arm blood-pressure monitor for an adult taking spot measurements at home. Reports systolic pressure, diastolic pressure and pulse; does not diagnose a condition or recommend treatment.
fields.intended_use: Adult home spot measurements; pediatric, ambulatory and emergency use excluded from this example.

fields.title: Take a dependable home measurement
fields.statement: An adult needs to obtain a usable reading at home and distinguish a completed measurement from an unsuccessful attempt.

fields.title: Fit the cuff without assistance
fields.statement: An adult needs to choose, apply and position the cuff on their own arm using the supplied instructions.

fields.title: Remain in control during inflation
fields.statement: A user needs to stop an uncomfortable measurement promptly and have the cuff release pressure even if normal control fails.

fields.title: Read and discuss previous measurements
fields.statement: A user needs to read the current result and retrieve their own dated readings when discussing them with a clinician.

fields.title: Maintain readiness between uses
fields.statement: A user needs to recognize when batteries or cleaning are required and prepare the monitor without specialist tools.

fields.title: Report a completed measurement
fields.statement: After a valid cycle, display systolic and diastolic pressure in mmHg and pulse in beats per minute together; never display an aborted cycle as a new result.
fields.acceptance: Bench signal scenarios produce all three labeled values; aborted-cycle scenarios retain no new result.

fields.title: Pressure-channel accuracy budget
fields.statement: The static cuff-pressure channel shall have error no greater than ±3 mmHg over 0–300 mmHg at 10–40 °C. Expanded operating band requires review of earlier allocations, compensation design and bench evidence.
fields.acceptance: Compare the pressure channel against a calibrated reference across the stated range. This draft target is not a clinical BP-accuracy criterion.

fields.title: Detect unsuitable measurement conditions
fields.statement: When the algorithm identifies excessive movement or inadequate signal quality, end the attempt with a retry message and do not store a numeric blood-pressure result.

fields.title: Fit the intended arm range
fields.statement: The supplied cuff shall fit an adult upper-arm circumference from 22 to 42 cm, with visible placement and range indications.
fields.acceptance: Draft product population assumption; assess fit at both endpoints and representative intermediate sizes.

fields.title: Teach cuff placement
fields.statement: The quick-start guide and cuff markings shall describe arm position, cuff alignment, tightening and preparation before a measurement.

fields.title: Limit cuff pressure
fields.statement: An independent protective function shall command pressure release before cuff pressure exceeds 300 mmHg under the defined single-fault scenarios.
fields.acceptance: Fictional safety allocation; final thresholds and fault set require risk review.

fields.title: Stop and release pressure
fields.statement: Pressing Stop during inflation or measurement shall stop the pump and reduce cuff pressure below 15 mmHg within 5 seconds.

fields.title: Release on power loss
fields.statement: Loss of battery power during a measurement shall leave a passive release path that reduces cuff pressure below 15 mmHg within 10 seconds.

fields.title: Readable result presentation
fields.statement: The result screen shall use distinct SYS, DIA and PULSE labels and digits at least 12 mm high; error screens shall explain the next action without showing a new BP result.

fields.title: Keep readings assigned to a user
fields.statement: The monitor shall store up to 60 completed readings for each of two user profiles, including measurement time; a profile change shall be visible before recall.

fields.title: Handle clock uncertainty
fields.statement: After clock reset or an unset clock, label new records as time-unset; do not silently assign an invented date.

fields.title: Warn before battery exhaustion
fields.statement: Show a low-battery indication before the next measurement becomes unavailable, and prevent a new cycle when the remaining battery state is below the defined start threshold.

fields.title: Support routine cleaning
fields.statement: User-accessible housing surfaces shall tolerate the specified cleaning method without loss of legibility or function over the proposed service life.
fields.acceptance: Cleaning agent, cycle count and service-life basis are unresolved; this requirement is deliberately not ready for verification.

fields.title: Establish clinical measurement performance
fields.statement: Establish blood-pressure measurement performance for the intended adult population using an applicable clinical evaluation plan.
fields.acceptance: Study design, reference method, population and acceptance criteria require a qualified clinical/regulatory review. Static sensor calibration is insufficient.

fields.title: Acquire calibrated pressure samples
fields.statement: The pressure acquisition subsystem shall provide calibrated cuff-pressure samples to the estimator at 100 samples per second.

fields.title: Allocate pressure error
fields.statement: At 15–35 °C, sensor calibration residual shall be within ±1.5 mmHg and conversion/compensation contribution within ±1.0 mmHg; retain 0.5 mmHg integration margin.

fields.title: Reject motion-corrupted estimates
fields.statement: The measurement estimator shall expose an invalid-quality state that prevents completion and storage when the motion rejection rule is triggered.

fields.title: Control pressure ramps
fields.statement: The pneumatic controller shall execute the requested inflation and deflation profiles while reporting pressure and actuator state to the cycle supervisor.

fields.title: Provide cuff geometry and markings
fields.statement: The cuff assembly shall provide overlap and retention across the intended arm range and keep artery alignment and range marks visible when applied.

fields.title: Independent overpressure response
fields.statement: A protection channel independent of the estimator shall inhibit the pump and open the release valve when its overpressure threshold is reached.

fields.title: Prioritize Stop input
fields.statement: The cycle supervisor shall handle Stop in every active measurement state and enter the venting state without waiting for an estimator response.

fields.title: Provide passive venting
fields.statement: The pneumatic assembly shall vent through a normally open path when its valve drive is unpowered.

fields.title: Separate results from errors
fields.statement: The presentation layer shall render completed-result and retry/error states using distinct layouts and labels.

fields.title: Persist a complete reading atomically
fields.statement: The record store shall commit profile, pressure values, pulse, clock-state flag and timestamp as one record; interrupted writes shall not create a partly populated reading.

fields.title: Recall only the active profile
fields.statement: The recall controller shall return records for the visible active profile and explicitly indicate an empty history.

fields.title: Preserve clock-state provenance
fields.statement: The clock service shall expose valid/unset status; the store and recall screen shall preserve and show that status for each saved reading.

fields.title: Evaluate battery state under load
fields.statement: The power supervisor shall assess battery voltage under the proposed pump load before permitting a cycle and provide low/unavailable states to the display.

fields.title: Supply preparation instructions
fields.statement: The labeling set shall illustrate seated posture, rest, supported arm and cuff positioning; clarify that a retry message is not a clinical reading.

fields.title: Qualify housing and printed labels
fields.statement: The enclosure and printed markings shall retain functional and reading characteristics after the selected cleaning regimen.

fields.title: Pressure transducer calibration table
fields.statement: Store sensor offset and span calibration with a checksum; reject an absent or corrupt table before measurement.

fields.title: Temperature compensation
fields.statement: Apply the characterized temperature compensation to the pressure conversion over the specified operating band.

fields.title: Sample timing budget
fields.statement: Pressure-sample timestamps shall remain within ±1 ms of the 10 ms schedule during measurement.

fields.title: Pump cutoff comparator
fields.statement: The independent comparator shall inhibit pump drive without relying on a firmware task; threshold tolerance shall be included in the 300 mmHg protection budget.

fields.title: Release valve flow
fields.statement: The selected valve and exhaust restriction shall meet active and passive release-time allocations at the worst-case cuff volume.

fields.title: Stop switch debounce
fields.statement: A stable Stop-switch assertion shall be delivered to the supervisor within 100 ms without multiple-trigger side effects.

fields.title: Cuff retention seam
fields.statement: The cuff fabric, bladder seam and hook-and-loop overlap shall retain the applied cuff through the defined inflation sequence at arm-range endpoints.

fields.title: LCD numeral geometry
fields.statement: Result numerals shall use the specified 12 mm character height and fixed positions for SYS, DIA and PULSE.

fields.title: Journaled record slot
fields.statement: Each record slot shall carry a checksum and commit marker; incomplete slots shall be excluded from recall after restart.

fields.title: Profile field in each record
fields.statement: Store the selected profile ID in each record rather than deriving it from the current UI setting.

fields.title: Battery divider calibration
fields.statement: Characterize divider and ADC error at the proposed low/start thresholds and include tolerance in the power-state decision.

fields.title: Clock validity flag
fields.statement: The clock module shall initialize as unset after loss of backup state and become valid only after explicit clock setup.

fields.title: Pressure acquisition board and calibration spec
fields.statement: Fictional schematic PAB-04 and calibration procedure CAL-02 define the transducer, ADC path and offset/span table format.
fields.artifact: Example document references only; no CAD files or released drawings exist.

fields.title: Pressure conversion firmware
fields.statement: Module pressure_conversion.c describes sample timing, checksum validation and temperature compensation for the pressure channel.

fields.title: Measurement estimator and quality gate
fields.statement: Module estimate_bp.c describes the oscillometric estimator and invalid-signal output. Algorithm/clinical performance remains unevaluated.

fields.title: Pneumatic assembly drawing
fields.statement: Drawing PNEU-03 describes pump, normally open release valve, tubing and exhaust restriction shared by Stop, power-loss and pressure-control functions.

fields.title: Independent protection schematic
fields.statement: Schematic SAFE-02 describes comparator threshold components and hardwired pump inhibition with release command.

fields.title: Cycle supervisor state machine
fields.statement: Design CYCLE-05 covers preparation, inflation, acquisition, invalid-signal, result, Stop and venting transitions.

fields.title: Cuff pattern and printing artwork
fields.statement: Pattern CUFF-07 defines bladder dimensions, fabric seam, retention overlap and artery/range markings for the proposed adult arm range.

fields.title: LCD and screen specification
fields.statement: UI-06 defines result, retry, recall, selected-profile, unset-time and battery screens; larger numeral layout consumes the lower prompt line.

fields.title: Record-store format
fields.statement: STORE-03 defines profile-specific journaled records, CRC and commit marker, with time validity recorded alongside values.

fields.title: Power supervision circuit and thresholds
fields.statement: PWR-04 describes pump-load assessment, divider calibration and low/unavailable battery thresholds.

fields.title: Quick-start guide draft
fields.statement: QSG-08 illustrates preparation, cuff placement, stopping an attempt, retry behavior, profile recall and the limits of the displayed measurement.

fields.title: Enclosure material and label draft
fields.statement: MECH-02 proposes an enclosure resin and printed label method; cleaning compatibility has not been selected or qualified.

fields.title: Pressure-channel bench characterization
fields.statement: Use a calibrated pressure reference at defined pressure points and temperatures; compare the complete channel and characterize allocated sensor/conversion errors.
fields.acceptance: Assess PRS-02 and SYS-02 separately; draft bench method does not validate clinical BP estimates.
fields.method: Controlled bench comparison; calibration and uncertainty assessment required.

fields.title: Sample timing and calibration fault injection
fields.statement: Instrument sample timestamps and inject missing/checksum-invalid calibration tables; assess timing and refusal to start.

fields.title: Invalid-signal state tests
fields.statement: Replay specified motion/noise traces and confirm retry presentation plus absence of a newly stored reading; coverage limited to the chosen signal scenarios.

fields.title: Cuff fit and retention inspection
fields.statement: Use circumference fixtures at 22, 32 and 42 cm, inspect range markings and retention after the specified inflation sequences; does not establish unaided user success.

fields.title: Independent overpressure fault tests
fields.statement: Inject a stalled supervisor and stuck pump command while monitoring reference pressure and protection-channel response; record fault coverage and peak pressure.

fields.title: Stop and passive-release timing
fields.statement: At worst-case cuff volume, activate Stop and separately remove power during inflation. Measure time to the stated residual-pressure threshold.

fields.title: Display content and geometry inspection
fields.statement: Inspect numeral dimensions and exercise result/error/profile screens against UI-06; photometric readability and intended-user success are outside this protocol.

fields.title: Interrupted-write and profile isolation
fields.statement: Interrupt writes at commit stages, restart, and recall both profiles; confirm complete records only and no cross-profile recall.

fields.title: Clock reset and unset-time recall
fields.statement: Remove clock backup state, save an example reading and confirm unset-time indication survives storage and recall.

fields.title: Battery-load boundary tests
fields.statement: Sweep simulated battery conditions under pump load and confirm low/unavailable thresholds include characterized voltage-measurement error.

fields.title: Labeling content inspection
fields.statement: Check the guide against the preparation, retry and Stop requirements; inspection of content does not establish that users understand it.

fields.title: Cleaning durability protocol draft
fields.statement: Placeholder for repeated cleaning exposure followed by inspection and function checks; no executable method exists until agent and cycle count are selected.

fields.title: Unaided home-use workflow study
fields.statement: Plan representative intended adult users performing preparation, cuff placement, measurement, retry and Stop with representative product and supplied labeling in a simulated home setting.
fields.acceptance: Document critical tasks, participants, use errors and root causes. Study plan and acceptance rationale require human-factors review.

fields.title: Result and recall comprehension study
fields.statement: Plan tasks where users distinguish unsuccessful attempts from completed readings, select their profile and identify an unset date before discussing records.

fields.title: Readiness and maintenance study
fields.statement: Plan intended-user tasks recognizing battery state and following the finalized cleaning instructions.

fields.title: Clinical performance plan placeholder
fields.statement: Clinical evaluation of estimated BP is a separate planned activity from usability and static pressure calibration. Study approach and applicable standards are unresolved.
fields.status: outline only; no approval or run

fields.title: Incorrect result mistaken for a valid reading
fields.statement: Pressure-channel or estimation errors may produce a misleading result used in a care discussion.
fields.hazardous_situation: User relies on an inaccurate displayed value.
fields.harm: Inappropriate follow-up or delayed care; example analysis only.
fields.residual_review: Open; requires clinical performance evaluation and full risk review.

fields.title: Poor cuff application corrupts measurement
fields.statement: A cuff outside its fit range or misaligned on the arm may produce an unusable or misleading result.
fields.residual_review: Open; fixture inspection does not resolve use-related risk.

fields.title: Sustained cuff pressure
fields.statement: Control or valve failure may leave excessive or prolonged cuff pressure while the user cannot release it normally.
fields.harm: Pain or tissue injury; example risk analysis only.
fields.residual_review: Open; RUN-06 exposes unresolved passive release.

fields.title: Another user's reading recalled
fields.statement: An incorrect profile association may cause a user to discuss someone else's readings as their own.
fields.residual_review: Open; software isolation and user comprehension need separate assessment.

fields.title: Unsuccessful cycle treated as a reading
fields.statement: A user may mistake stale numbers or an error state for a newly completed measurement.

fields.title: Cleaning damages function or labels
fields.statement: An incompatible cleaner may damage the enclosure or erase important labels.
fields.residual_review: Open; cleaning method and lifetime basis unresolved.

fields.title: Pressure calibration and quality gate
fields.statement: Allocate pressure-channel error, reject calibration faults and suppress results when signal quality is unsuitable; does not replace clinical evaluation.

fields.title: Fit-range markings and preparation guide
fields.statement: Supply cuff geometry, visible range/alignment marks and task instructions; assess both physical fit and user application.

fields.title: Independent pressure protection
fields.statement: Use a hardware protection channel to inhibit the pump and command venting independently of normal firmware.

fields.title: Stop and unpowered vent path
fields.statement: Provide a prioritized Stop transition and normally open passive release path.

fields.title: Profile-specific records and visible selection
fields.statement: Store a profile ID per record and keep current profile visible during recall.

fields.title: Distinct retry and completed-result states
fields.statement: Prevent invalid-result storage and visually distinguish retry instructions from completed measurements.

fields.title: Qualified cleaning materials and method
fields.statement: Select and qualify compatible housing, labels and user cleaning instructions; presently a proposed control.

fields.title: Expand home operating temperature band
fields.statement: Fictional product review expands the pressure-channel accuracy condition from 15–35 °C to 10–40 °C. Existing bench evidence and allocations were captured before this edit.
fields.disposition: Input edited; allocations, design and V&V assessment open.

fields.statement: Proposed restriction change addresses simulated passive-release failure; review impact on controlled deflation, estimation quality, noise and Stop timing before adopting it. The simulated RUN-06 passive-release finding motivates investigation. No corrected design, executed comparison or approval is recorded.
